Name: Thorns
Effect: Deal X damage back to every attacker that hits you. Lose 1 thorn per hit (the Vined Encasing variant instead sheds thorns equal to the damage taken). Adds on top of permanent sphere thorns and Barbed Exterior's maintained thorns.
Expiry Model: Timed (tempo) and value decays per hit
Stacking & Re-apply: Stackable: re-applying adds the value and keeps the longer timer
Sphere Grid Amp: Thorns +N (permanent sphere thorns, separate from the buff)
Sources: Vined Encasing [Briarhide Plate] (thorns = current armor, 20 tempo, sheds by damage); Studded Belt on-self (3, 5t); Treebeards Branch on-self (3, 5t); Spiked Mitts (5 per 25 armor gained, 5t) and its skill Well Placed Guard (5, 5t); Hallowed Trunk skill Imbue Tree (10, 5t); Spiked Shield (1 per cycle, 5t); Brad passive Vines Codependence (1-8 on a direct heal, 5t)
Notes: The Treant strips Thorns. Barbed Exterior (maintained_thorns = 5) is a Power card, not this buff.

Name: Focused
Effect: Gain 10 extra mana at the start of each cycle.
Stacking & Re-apply: Not stackable: re-applying keeps the longer timer
Sources: None in the live game (only the unconnected debug 'Test' hook in main.gd)
Notes: Defined and ticking, but nothing currently grants it.

Name: Regen
Effect: Heal X HP at the start of each cycle; X drops by 1 at the end of each cycle. Regen ticks do not count as 'real heals' for heal-triggered passives.
Expiry Model: Timed (tempo) and value decays 1 per cycle
Stacking & Re-apply: Stackable: re-applying adds the value and keeps the longer timer
Sources: Brad: Vines Codependence passive (0-7, 5t), Living Armor (tops Regen back up to the Fortify mark, 5t); Ryan: Mad Scientist Utility->Heal (2-8, 15t); Ring of Thomas the Train Tracks on shuffle (7, 10 at Lv3, 15t); Vanguard shield (1 per cycle, 15t); Treebeards Branch on Overdraw (3, 15t); Wooden Plank on dropping below 50% HP (1, 15t); Hallowed Trunk per 10 armor lost (1, 15t) and Imbue Tree (5, 15t); From the Ashes [Wand of the Phoenix Feather] (half the burn, permanent); Tricks of Alberich [Ring of Nibelung] (2 per enemy taunted, 15t)
Notes: Natures Grace (sphere_bonus_regen), Death as Lifeblood and the boot regen auras are separate stat regen, not this buff.

Name: Blessed
Effect: Draw X additional card(s) at the start of each cycle for Y cycles; one charge burns per cycle.
Stacking & Re-apply: Not stackable: re-applying keeps the higher charge count
Sources: Succumb (Brad): 2 extra draws for 4 cycles

Name: Fortify
Effect: Armor does not decay. Remembers the Regen value you had when it began (Living Armor tops Regen back up to that mark).
Stacking & Re-apply: Not stackable: re-applying keeps the longer timer
Sources: Turtle Up (Brad, 20t); Hunker Down (Brad, 30t); Succumb (Brad, 20t); Sword Breaker on-self (5t)

Name: Enlightened
Effect: +X% crit chance on your next Y attacks. Every attack roll spends a charge, crit or not. A value of 100 is a guaranteed crit.
Stacking & Re-apply: Not stackable: re-applying keeps the higher charge count (never adds); a higher % replaces a lower one
Sphere Grid Amp: Enlight Amp (+% crit, except on 100% sources)
Sources: Lady Luck (Jeremy, 30%, 5); Gift from the Gods [Megingjord] (10%, 3 charges, 4 at Lv3); Tighten String (Stephen, 20%, 1 per buffed shot); Understanding (Ryan, 100%, 1, after a 10t countdown); Scouted passive (Stephen, 100%, 1, after 3 hits in a row on one enemy); Serial Killer passive (Cory, 100%, 1, on the ambush attack)
Notes: Damaging cards that never roll crit (Exposed Artery, Shield Slam, God of Thunder, Balistic Arrow, flat item AOEs) neither use nor spend it.

Sources: Belt of Wumbology on-self (10, 2); Tight Rope [Boots of the Balancer] (15, 1); Feed into the Pain [Hammer of Ajax] (20, 4); Cyclops Ring after three 25+ hits (15, 2); Draupnir when the clone dies (10, 2); Biscuit (Jeremy, 3, 3; also via Risk It); Hope This Works (Jeremy, 2, 3, on success); Bloodlust (Ryan, timed: 3 for 20t); Succumb (Brad, timed: 5 for 20t); Mad Scientist Attack->Heal (Ryan, 2-8, 3); Easy Target (Stephen, 1-15, 3); Dominate (Stephen, 2-16, 3); Circle of Life on shuffle (Cory, 10-24, 3)
